name.description: asset name (becomes the file name); must be non-empty

cycleDuration.description: duration of one full stride cycle (s), > 0

stanceFraction.description: stance fraction of the cycle; the rest is swing, in (0, 1)

legPhases.description: per-leg phase offset (fraction of the cycle) in [0, 1); size must equal legs

legs.description: leg chains (one per leg): [{ name (non-empty), hipOffset: [x,y,z], upperLength > 0, lowerLength > 0, restOffset: [x,y,z], maxReach >= 0 (0 = auto upper+lower), hipBone/kneeBone/footBone (>= 0 binds; -1 = unbound; distinct when set) }]
